advisories_closed.summary: SSRF and path traversal in the OpenAPI provider
OAuth proxy token reuse across MCP servers
missing consent verification in the OAuth proxy callback
depended on an MCP SDK without DNS rebinding protection
command injection in the Gemini CLI installer
Windows command injection in the Cursor installer
reflected XSS in the client's OAuth callback page
DNS rebinding protection not enabled by default (HTTP servers)
HTTP transports serve session requests without verifying the principal
WebSocket server transport without Host/Origin validation
unbounded session accumulation in the StreamableHTTP transport

advisories_open.summary: post-transform component authorization is skipped on direct calls
advisories_open.why: the servers use no component authorization policy, no transform and no proxy template (stdio only, the clinician's own token; the backend authorizes every object and, under RC-121, the run's scope). The fix (fastmcp >= 3.4.10) needs Starlette >= 1.0.1, i.e. FastAPI >= 0.13x for the whole backend: an owner decision (D-AGT-8)
